title: How does a subscription keep charging you?

lines.text: Why is signing up for a streaming subscription a single click, but canceling feels like solving an ancient labyrinth?
Companies deliberately deploy manipulative website user interfaces called dark patterns.
lines.caps: Companies use dark *patterns | designed to trap your *wallet!

lines.text: They hide cancellation buttons in tiny gray text behind five layers of warning menus.
lines.caps: Hide cancel buttons in *tiny | gray text behind *menus

lines.text: Behind the scenes, when you enter payment details, you authorize a recurring merchant billing agreement.
Even if your physical debit card expires or is replaced, Visa and Mastercard Account Updater services automatically link your new card.
lines.caps: Card updater services *link | your new card *automatically!

lines.text: The subscription model relies on break-even breakage: millions of customers forgetting they are billed ten dollars a month.
Audit your bank statements monthly to eliminate vampire subscriptions draining your wallet.
lines.caps: Audit your bank *statements | to cancel forgotten *fees!
